text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> seems to have sustained a slight injury…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But summer camp only comes around once a year, and time is ticking. What to do…
choice_data_list: Make her take a proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to concentrate fully on treatment and recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> seems to be feeling a little depressed because she can't get any exercise…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to enthusiastically encourage <chrname> to keep going…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it all goes wrong! Now it seems like the injury has gotten even worse…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the injury is miraculously healed! Practice goes perfectly!
